request.style: English, powerful gospel, soaring female lead vocal with full gospel choir, Hammond organ, piano, bass, drums, call and response, bold and triumphant, 104 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The king set up a golden image high upon the plain
When the music played the nations bowed, they bowed and bowed again
But three young men stood upright when the horn began to sound
Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego would not bow down

[Chorus]
Our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the blazing furnace
And he will deliver us from your hand, O king
But if not, know this, O king
We will not serve your gods
And we will not worship the golden image you have set up

[Verse]
Seven times hotter roared the fire, the king was full of rage
They bound them in their robes and turbans, threw them in the blaze
The flames leapt out and killed the guards who brought them to the door
But the king rose up astonished at the sight he saw once more

[Bridge]
Did we not throw three men, bound, into the fire
I see four men, unbound, walking around in the middle of the fire
And the fourth looks like a son of the gods
Not a hair of their heads was singed
No smell of fire clung to them

[Chorus]
Our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the blazing furnace
And he will deliver us from your hand, O king
But if not, know this, O king
We will not serve your gods
And we will not worship the golden image you have set up

[Outro]
Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego
Who sent his angel and rescued his servants who trusted in him
